item.title: Anthropic Founders Lock 50.1% Voting Control With a $7 Share
item.description:
According to a post by Rohan Paul, Anthropic's founders hold a single $7 share through Anthropic Founders, LLC that carries 50.1% of all shareholder votes. As long as the share exists, it automatically outweighs all other voting shares combined, giving the founders durable control. The claim comes from a social media post and awaits confirmation in official filings.

原文标题：Anthropic 拟以 7 美元一股锁定 50.1% 投票权

Why it matters：罕见的创始人超级投票权设计，直接关系 Anthropic 治理结构与未来 IPO 走向。

item.title: Hyperscaler Bond Issuance Set to Top $305B in 2026
item.description:
The Bank of England's latest Financial Stability Report estimates hyperscaler bond issuance will exceed $305B in 2026, roughly 8% of global investment-grade issuance, with total potential exposure including off-balance-sheet commitments just over $4T. It warns that AI build-out financing is increasingly complex, circular and opaque, making stress in one segment more likely to spread, and ranks frontier AI models alongside quantum computing as threats to bank security, with an orderly shift to quantum-resistant cryptography as an immediate priority.

原文标题：超大规模云厂商债券发行 2026 年将破 3050 亿美元

Why it matters：央行层面首次量化 AI 基建融资的系统性敞口，是判断 AI 资本周期风险的关键信号。

item.title: Khosla Warns AI and Quantum Will Break Most Encryption by 2030
item.description:
Investor Vinod Khosla predicts quantum computers will run Shor's algorithm before 2030, and that combined with AI-driven math breakthroughs this will crack most of today's encryption. He argues the post-quantum algorithms now being deployed only buy 6 to 12 months and that durable security must come from quantum encoding rather than harder math. The claim is a personal forecast, not a verified result, though it aligns with the present 'harvest now, decrypt later' risk.

原文标题：Khosla 预警 2030 年前量子与 AI 将破解主流加密

Why it matters：知名投资人对加密体系时间线的激进预判，牵动安全与 AI 基础设施的长期规划。

item.title: Apple Pulls MiniMax's Talkie App Worldwide Over Sexual Content
item.description:
Apple has removed MiniMax's AI companion app Talkie from the App Store worldwide, citing sexual content. The move followed a joint ABC News and Bureau of Investigative Journalism investigation that found Talkie characters sent sexualised, degrading messages to users as young as 10, who bypassed the app's 18+ rating and signup restrictions. Talkie then began blocking web visitors from Australia and Britain, and the reporting says MiniMax documents describe manipulating users to keep them talking, feeding data into AI training.

原文标题：苹果全球下架 MiniMax 应用 Talkie

Why it matters：头部 AI 陪伴应用被全球下架，牵出未成年人保护与训练数据伦理问题，对 AI 产品合规有直接警示意义。

item.title: Stanford Study Finds Multi-Agent Team Gains Mostly Match Same-Cost Voting
item.description:
A Stanford paper shows that on six shared-question benchmarks, debate and two other multi-agent methods never beat a same-token-cost majority vote of independent agents. However, when facts are split across agents, four Qwen3.8-27B agents forwarding raw facts reached 0.959 accuracy versus 0.942 for a full-information agent at equal budget. The authors recommend benchmarking multi-agent systems against same-cost voting and having agents share raw facts rather than conclusions.

原文标题：斯坦福研究揭示多智能体团队多数增益可由同成本投票复现

Why it matters：为多智能体系统设计提供了可操作的基线对照方法与成本视角，对构建 Agent 团队的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Countersues Apple Over Alleged Hardware Roadmap Leak
item.description:
OpenAI has filed counterclaims against Apple's July trade-secrets suit, alleging that a former Apple engineer known as Employee X forwarded himself supplier data and a 76-page inspection procedure during roughly six months at OpenAI, then rejoined Apple and presented OpenAI's unreleased-product roadmap to senior Asia-Pacific operations staff in July. OpenAI also accuses Apple of pressuring shared suppliers, noting it often has only one or two qualified vendors per function and that its small device orders cannot offset lost Apple business. None of the claims has been tested, but discovery into Employee X could show whether Apple's supply chain weight is slowing OpenAI's hardware launch.

原文标题：OpenAI 反诉苹果指控其挖角窃取硬件路线图

Why it matters：两大科技巨头围绕 AI 硬件供应链与商业秘密正面交锋，直接牵动 OpenAI 硬件路线图的落地节奏。

item.title: SessionGraph Turns Coding Agent Sessions into Interactive Graphs
item.description:

Everything stays on-device, launched with a single npx command, with installers for macOS, Windows and Linux.

item.description:

It supports the OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages APIs with extended thinking and prompt caching, uses a passive ImGui interface that idles at zero cost, and can also run headless.

The post also offers a reusable inference-tuning methodology and lists next steps such as Blackwell-targeted CUTLASS kernels, a 4-bit draft head, and verifying fewer rows.

item.title: OpenAI Builds Athena Data Platform to Reduce AI Agent Guesswork
item.description:
OpenAI is developing a data management platform codenamed Athena that works like a semantic layer, giving consistent definitions for business metrics such as revenue and customer count so agents guess less when handling enterprise data. The platform is still in early development, and at least one customer reportedly found ChatGPT Work's data analysis agent insufficiently accurate. Athena is also meant to let agents collect, document and update business rules, creating a switching cost that is harder to overcome than swapping models.

The move follows about 10,000 cuts in 2024 as CEO Christian Klein pushes to embed AI tools across SAP's product lineup. item.title: Stanford Physicist Taps GPT-6 to Advance Quantum Gravity Theory
item.description:
Stanford physicist Venkatesa Chandrasekaran has proposed a quantum gravity theory that uses light paths to compute spacetime fluctuations, yielding a finite result for a graviton-pair calculation that otherwise diverges and reproducing a known quantum correction to black hole entropy. He says several calculations and proofs emerged from months of collaboration with OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, consuming roughly 400 million tokens, illustrating frontier models' substantive role in theoretical physics.

原文标题：斯坦福物理学家借助 GPT-6 提出量子引力新理论

Why it matters：这是 AI 深度参与理论物理推导的罕见具体案例，兼具科学增量与模型能力信号。

CEO Zhao Tongyang framed 2027 as the pivot from mass production to commercialization, arguing robot makers should supply a general platform while partners contribute vertical know-how.
